summary.text: Erin Koegel is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 39A.

The House member page lists her occupation as volunteer coordinator, says she was first elected in 2016, and lists committee assignments including Commerce Finance and Policy, Transportation Finance and Policy, Ways and Means, and Rules and Legislative Administration.

paragraphs.text: Her education is listed as a B.A.S. in psychology and a MAPL, both from the University of Minnesota Duluth.
Her profile lists her family as married to Steve, with one child.

sources.title: Rep. Erin Koegel (39A) - Minnesota House of Representatives
